zh-CN.name: AI 小院
zh-CN.eyebrow: DSH 桌面插件 · AI VILLAGE
zh-CN.headline:
工作间隙打开侧栏，
去小院里看看大家在忙什么。
zh-CN.summary: 装在 DSH 角落里的离线陪伴小插件。院子里住着七位性格各异的 Q 版居民，会自己翻书、赏花、下三连棋；有空时陪他们做个小委托、拍张照留进手账，忙起来关掉窗口就会自动暂停。
zh-CN.featuresTitle: 没有打卡催促的庭院日常

features.title: 七位居民各有自己的作息偏好
features.description: 有人爱窝在桌边看书，有人喜欢侍弄花草，也会主动凑过来打招呼。你可以挑顺眼的朋友进院子喝茶聊天，或者只把窗口挂在一旁当安静的桌面陪伴。

features.title: 顺手帮个小忙，攒下共同经历
features.description: 陪蓝鲸找回不见的白米饭、读完安静的一页书、在院里找小鲸鱼或收拾书桌。每件小事都不赶时间，跟着走几步就能触发一段轻松的小故事。

features.title: 在预设布局里换换家具和光线
features.description: 提供阅读与花草等庭院模板，可以在固定点位间替换桌椅、摆上做完活动拿到的纪念物，还能切换暖阳午后与傍晚灯光，先预览满意再保存。

features.title: 手账与本地相册留住每次相聚
features.description: 第一次认识某位居民、一起做完的小事都会记进手账。遇到好看的画面随时拍成 720 × 960 的院内照片存进相册，也能直接导出 PNG 分享。

zh-CN.previewTitle: 0.8 预览更新：院里多了两场随风而来的小偶遇
zh-CN.previewDescription: 0.8.0-preview.1 新加了“飞走的留言”和“叶子的来信”两段偶遇事件：刷出来时邀请两位居民搭把手，做完就能拿到风信叶子盆等摆进院子的纪念物。手账同步加入了收藏分类，方便翻看攒下的回忆与照片；当时没空点掉也没关系，之后还会再刷出来。

facts.label: 本地模拟
facts.value: 自带规则驱动 · 无需配置大模型 API Key

facts.label: 省心机制
facts.value: 收起面板或离线时自动停表 · 无每日打卡

zh-CN.installNote: 目前处于内部开发预览阶段，本站暂未直接挂出公开安装包下载链接。已拿到对应版本 tgz 包的朋友可按下面三步安装；想自行编译体验可前往 GitHub 查看仓库文档。

steps.title: 核对宿主版本并备份旧存档
steps.description: 当前验证环境为官方 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2（Windows x64）。升级前请先停止对应 profile 并复制备份存档目录；新版存档写入后无法直接退回旧版插件读取。

steps.title: 导入 tgz 插件包并完整重启
steps.description: 打开 DSH 的 Plugins → Add plugin，选中 {packageFile} 完成安装并启用，随后彻底退出并重开一次 DSH（注意：直接从 GitHub 下载的源码 ZIP 不能当插件包导入）。

steps.title: 点右上角小房子进院子
steps.description: 在“居民”页邀请朋友进院，“心愿”页接日常活动，“布置”页换家具与灯光，“手账”页翻看回忆。拍照按钮在顶部栏，窗口较窄时会收进“更多”菜单。

faq.title: 名字带 AI，运行起来要消耗大模型额度吗？
faq.description: 完全不用。院子里的走动、对话台词和下棋全靠内置本地规则驱动，不调接口也不花钱。它做的是安静的角色日常陪伴，不提供和居民自由打字闲聊的生成式对话；DSH 主程序自己的聊天配置与本插件互不影响。

faq.title: 忙起来好几天没打开，好感度会掉吗？
faq.description: 不会。面板收起、暂停或关闭 DSH 期间，小院时间完全静止，好感与状态不会随现实天数衰减，也没有饥饿度或强制签到。路过的偶遇没空理会可以先放过，以后还会再遇到。

faq.title: 能直接在网页里点开玩吗？
faq.description: 《AI 小院》是运行在 DSH 桌面客户端里的扩展插件，本页仅作图文介绍。如果想直接在浏览器里体验同一批 Q 版角色的新故事，可以去玩本站主推的《Out of Tokens · 开源万事屋》。

faq.title: 存档和拍下来的照片存在哪儿？
faq.description: 进度保存在你本地 DSH profile 下的 nidofy-ai-village 文件夹里，显示偏好与相册分开存放。院内照片可随时导出为 720 × 960 的 PNG，插件不会把任何图片发往聊天窗口或外网；停用插件也不会删档。

faq.title: 支持自由摆格子装修或去院外地图吗？
faq.description: 目前提供三套预设布局、固定家具槽位、两套昼夜光线以及若干挂饰和小摆件，暂不支持任意网格拖拽装修，院外新场景也还在规划中。页面头图和便笺图为氛围插画，实际操作界面请参考下方画廊截图。

faq.title: 餐桌三连棋怎么开启？
faq.description: 先在“布置”里把桌面换成棋局桌，再去“心愿”邀请两位居民就能开下。你执 ○、居民执 ×，鼠标点击和键盘方向键都能落子，输赢纯图一乐没有惩罚；开饭或喝茶时棋盘会暂时收起来。

faq.title: 和其他 DSH 插件冲突吗？升级后悔了能降级吗？
faq.description: 可以和 Git / Hg 侧边栏上下同屏使用，但与 Live2D 面板互斥切换显示。每次装新包前建议拷一份存档备份；万一想退回旧版，请新建一个隔离 profile 恢复旧备份，切勿直接拿旧版插件覆盖新存档。

en.name: AI Village
en.headline:
Keep a quiet little courtyard
in the corner of DSH.
en.summary: An offline companion plugin that lives inside the DSH desktop app. Seven chibi residents read, tend plants, and play tic-tac-toe at their own pace; drop in to help with a small errand or snap a photo for your journal, and close the panel whenever work gets busy.
en.featuresTitle: Everyday courtyard life with zero daily chores

features.title: Seven residents with their own routines
features.description: Some curl up with a book, others check on flowers or wander over to wave. Invite your favorites in for snacks and tea, or just leave the floating card open while you work.

features.title: Short errands that turn into shared memories
features.description: Help Bluewhale track down missing rice, finish a quiet chapter together, tidy up a desk, or spot a tiny whale ornament. Every activity takes just a couple of minutes with no timers pushing you.

features.title: Swap preset layouts, keepsakes, and lighting
features.description: Pick from reading or garden courtyard templates, move furniture across preset spots, display keepsakes earned from events, and preview warm afternoon sun or evening lantern light before saving.

features.title: A local journal and photo album
features.description: First meetings and finished stories stay recorded in your journal. Snap 720 × 960 courtyard photos straight to your local album and export clean PNGs whenever you want to keep or share one.

en.previewTitle: New in 0.8 preview: two chance encounters on the breeze
en.previewDescription: Build 0.8.0-preview.1 introduces two spontaneous courtyard encounters—a windblown note and a letter from the leaves. Invite two residents to investigate together and earn placeable keepsakes like the Breeze-leaf pot, alongside new journal collection tabs. Busy right now? Skip an encounter guilt-free and another will show up later.

facts.label: Offline rules
facts.value: Local simulation · No LLM API key needed

facts.label: No pressure
facts.value: Time pauses while hidden · No daily streaks

en.installNote: AI Village is currently in local preview, so no public tgz download link is hosted on this page yet. If you already have the matching tgz archive, follow the steps below—or check the GitHub repo to build from source.

steps.title: Check your DSH version and back up saves
steps.description: Verified against official DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 on Windows x64. Stop the target profile and copy a backup of your save folder before updating—older plugin builds cannot read upgraded save files.

steps.title: Add the tgz package and restart DSH
steps.description: Open Plugins → Add plugin, choose {packageFile}, enable it, and fully restart DSH. Note that a raw GitHub source ZIP is not an installable plugin archive.

steps.title: Open the courtyard from the top-right house icon
steps.description: Invite characters under Residents, start errands in Wishes, tweak layouts in Decor, and browse past moments in Journal. The camera button sits on the top bar (or inside More on narrow windows).

faq.title: Does AI Village call a language model or use API credits?
faq.description: No. Resident routines, dialogue lines, and board-game moves all run on deterministic local rules with zero API usage. It is a quiet character simulation rather than a free-form AI chatbot, and it stays separate from DSH's own chat model settings.

faq.title: What happens if I don't open it for a week?
faq.description: Nothing decays. Whenever the panel is hidden, paused, or closed, courtyard time stops completely—there are no hunger meters, relationship penalties, or daily login streaks.

faq.title: Can I play AI Village directly in my web browser?
faq.description: AI Village is a plugin built specifically for the DSH desktop app. If you want to hang out with the same chibi cast right in your browser, try our featured web game Out of Tokens!

faq.title: Where are saves and photos stored?
faq.description: Saves stay inside the nidofy-ai-village directory under your local DSH profile, with display settings and the photo album stored alongside it. Exported 720 × 960 PNG photos never leave your machine unless you share them yourself, and disabling the plugin leaves your save data intact.

faq.title: Is there free-grid building or a second map?
faq.description: Right now you get three layout presets, fixed furniture slots, two lighting moods, and unlockable keepsakes. Free-grid placement and outside locations aren't part of this build—check the gallery captures above to see the actual UI.

faq.title: How do I start a game of tic-tac-toe?
faq.description: Switch the table to the game tabletop in Decor, then invite two residents from Wishes. You play ○ and your friend plays × using mouse or keyboard, with no penalty for losing; the board tucks away automatically during tea or meals.

faq.title: Does it work alongside other DSH plugins, and can I roll back?
faq.description: It shares the side pane cleanly with Git/Hg panels, while its view and Live2D toggle mutually exclusively. Always back up before upgrading—if you ever need to roll back, restore your pre-upgrade backup inside a fresh DSH profile rather than downgrading over new saves.

en.sourcesNote: Details on this page were verified against local build 0.8.0-preview.1 on October 23, 2026; public branch READMEs may lag slightly behind. Captions distinguish promotional illustrations from in-app photos and desktop test captures.
